_comment: Committed with the repo; never put secrets here. platform: mobile|android|web. mobile (iOS) uses appId + buildCmd/installCmd + simulator; android uses appId + buildCmd/installCmd and the first online adb device; web uses url (flows also carry url: themselves). errorCopy = the app's literal error-state strings, greped from source, used by screen-walk assertNotVisible. envKeys = the credential keys the user must fill in ~/.scout/<project>/.env.
